description:
Nothing stops the public surface from growing: no `#![warn(unreachable_pub)]` or
equivalent exists in src/, runtime/src/, Cargo.toml, clippy.toml or .github/.

## Verified at main 417c5b0b5

The RUNTIME half matches the old ticket exactly. `runtime/src/heap/mod.rs:23`
declares `mod gc;` -- PRIVATE, inside `pub mod heap` -- and
`grep -rn "^\s*pub fn " runtime/src/heap/gc | wc -l` -> 17. All 17 are
unreachable, which is precisely the ticket's "17 function candidates, all under
runtime/src/heap/gc".

The FZ half: src/lib.rs exports only `pub mod compiler2`, `pub mod ground_value`,
`pub mod types`, plus `pub use function_surface::FunctionSurface` and
`pub use telemetry::sink::NullTelemetry`. Everything else is a private `mod`.

There are 765 `pub fn` in src/, of which 169 sit in fully-private top-level
modules and are unreachable BY CONSTRUCTION:

    telemetry 60, fz_ir 32, diag 22, exec 17, ir_codegen 9, source 9,
    modules 8, ast 4, parser 4, type_expr 2, ir_dce 1, ir_interp 1

src/compiler2/mod.rs declares 39 of its 41 submodules as private `mod` (only
`pub mod pull` and `pub(crate) mod callsite_dispatch` differ), so the large
majority of the 594 `pub fn` under src/compiler2 are candidates too, minus
whatever `pub use` re-exports pull types into reach.

## Could not verify

The headline numbers -- 655 unreachable public items, 357 function/method
candidates. `cargo rustc -p fz --lib -- -D unreachable_pub` recompiles the crate,
which was not available during triage. The counts above are a LOWER BOUND on the
fz side and an exact match on the runtime side. Re-take the baseline before
slicing.

## Correction to the old strategy note

It says "Do not touch exported API in src/lib.rs (`run`, `FunctionSurface`,
`compiler2`, `types`)". There is no `run` in src/lib.rs today. The guard list
needs `ground_value` and `NullTelemetry` ADDED and `run` DROPPED.

## Checks

- A fresh `-D unreachable_pub` baseline is recorded before any slicing.
- `#![warn(unreachable_pub)]` (or the clippy equivalent) is enabled so the
  surface cannot silently regrow -- without a ratchet this ticket recurs.
- src/lib.rs's five exported items stay exported.
title: Restrict unreachable public functions to crate visibility, and add a ratchet so the surface cannot regrow
